mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 9.5% and industrial production below 92.0 indicates a deepening economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through dual demand and supply shocks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5% AND INDPRO < 92.0.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL month-over-month change exceeding 0.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 500.0 thousand units signal weak consumer demand and reduced economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced construction and related spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous retail sales below 370,000 million dollars and housing starts below 500.0 thousand units indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumption and investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 370000 AND HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 92.0 (2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing output and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate capacity utilization.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 92.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp month-over-month CPI increase exceeding 0.3% signals immediate inflation pressure, prompting short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.3%.
